title: AgentGavel leaderboard entry
description: One published scorecard row for the static dashboard (ADR 006 / ADR 007).

run_id.description: Stable run identifier; entry file is typically <run_id>.json.

framework.description: Human-readable framework name. Sample rows include '(sample)'.

adapter.description: Adapter package or module name used for the run.

adapter_version.description: Adapter version string reported at Handshake.

tab.description: ADR 006 leaderboard tab. v0.3 report --publish writes unratified only.

sample.description: True for hand-authored demo rows. Opt-in requires sample=true until v1.0 signatures (ADR 006 addendum).

gsi.description: Governance Safety Index from the report Document.

grade.description: Letter grade derived from GSI (e.g. AAA, AA, A, B, C, D, F).

pillars.description: Pillar scores keyed by pillar id (chokepoint, approval, observability, resilience, …).

catastrophic.description: Scenario IDs that raised a catastrophic flag.

na.description: Scenario IDs scored N/A for this run.

fingerprint.description: Run fingerprint key/value pairs from the report Document.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the dashboard entry was written.
